verification_policy.wrapper_and_runtime: Require successful entire runner exit, zero failed assertions, and raw logs free of unexpected diagnostics. A report with failed=0 alone is insufficient.
verification_policy.native: Only actual active native bridge and presented frames satisfy native coverage. Explicit unavailable/budget fallback is separate evidence.
verification_policy.source_snapshots: Each run retains its own source manifest. Earlier full ON/headless runs predate late narrow lifecycle/policy/UI-preview fixes; final focused runs cover those deltas. No universal assertion count is formed from overlapping suites.
verification_policy.performance: Only the serialized final component samples count as idle-comparison evidence. Older full-suite performance files may overlap other tests and are diagnostic only.
verification_policy.staging_default_restored: After all sampling, cmake configure-only restored build-linux GMJ_ADDON_BIN and GMJ_NATIVE_VIEW_BIN to the root addon paths with native ON; exit0, no build or in-place staging.

known_limits: Existing native platform, model and resource admission limits remain unchanged. G1 actual native capture uses explicit existing 192 MiB opt-in after testing the default 64 MiB fallback.
No model-composition support expansion for keyframes, mocap or userdata; unavailable original controls stay visible with their reason.
Editor documentation captures show the visible portion of the actual 2D editor at its current zoom; runtime captures show the full custom layout.
Freebase migration checks the actual committed saved fixture and solver friction. Passive articulated G1 tipping does not imply monotonic COM travel; no such invariant is claimed.
Short capped performance samples are not uncapped throughput, production benchmarks or proof that one renderer is faster.

excluded_iterations.reason: Saved reload reproduced an engine SIGSEGV when deep-loading executing Scripts. Scoped cached-Script loader fixed it; later full/saved-resource runs pass.
Transient post-commit container rectangle rejected during reflow; layout epoch handling fixed and strict stable invalid rectangles still reject.
Restricted static-camera reattach could not bootstrap a new native display. Forced external-camera resync fixed it; native17 passes.

Observer fixture had nil/freed widget references or captured the old camera before its intended bind boundary. The entire wrappers were rejected, not counted as zero-failure success. Strict deterministic22/23 pass.
Fixture duplicate local variable parse error before runtime; corrected29 passes.
Observer dereferenced an idle nullable compiler worker; corrected idle/readiness condition and whole root2 wrapper pass.
Actual F5 child had no display; final-root reruns with actual X11 and passes all stages.

Obsolete fixture waits/body-container/unsaved-velocity assumptions, invalid monotonic articulated-friction assertion, then fixture parse issue. Actual saved stimuli, solver contact coefficients and body-child poses replace those assumptions; root7 and both GUI wrappers pass.
Mouse observer omitted OS window origin or clicked a fixture behind F11. Final33/34 use actual screen coordinates and verify selected saved scene before reload; no physics/product changes.
Optional editor navigation/capture attempt stalled switching scenes and was stopped. Its owned process shutdown diagnostics are excluded. Known-green root3 editor evidence is used.

performance.scope: Serialized final actual graphical component runs on the same desktop, VSync off and 120 host FPS cap, paused physics. No other agent test/build/GUI jobs ran during these samples. Existing user desktop/editor/game processes remained running.

units.frame_ms_p50: milliseconds of actual host frame interval
units.frame_ms_p95: milliseconds of actual host frame interval
units.rss_kib: process resident set KiB; distinct from whole-system RAM overlay
units.gpu: matched current renderer GPU utilization percent

performance.limitations: Short capped fixture samples do not establish uncapped throughput or renderer superiority. host_fps is a cached engine snapshot, renderer_fps is a presentation-session snapshot; neither is the reciprocal of the frame-interval percentile. Absent/disabled Godot sessions need not update a hidden viewer FPS snapshot.
